alternate_skip.ramble_1:
This setting will skip processing json files under the `_alternatives` folder,
meaning you'll just get the "main" titles for the cores which sort their JSON files this way.
alternate_skip.ramble_2: Warning: turning this off will mean that installing Required Files takes much longer.
alternate_skip.title: Skip Alternate Assets

hide_ai_score.title: Hide AI Score
hide_ai_score.ramble: This will hide any parts of the UI which try to judge & present the amount of AI which has been used in developing a core.

archive.title: ROM & BIOS archive (Required Files)
archive.warning:
Please check with your local laws around the downloading of potentially copyrighted (arcade) ROM & BIOS files.
If you are comfortable with this, copy the following url into the input and hit "save".

github_token.title: Github Token
github_token.ramble:
If you're having issues with the GitHub rate limit, then add a PAT token below.
The PAT token shouldn't have any scopes set, and is stored on your computer rather than on the Pocket's SD card.

clear_file_cache.ramble:
To help with USB & SD card transfer larger files are copied & stored on your computer's file system,
which should be fine but if you're running into issues try clearing the file cache.
clear_file_cache.title: Clear file cache

disconnect.ramble: Return to the "Connect To Pocket" screen (This doesn't eject the SD Card / USB drive)
disconnect.title: Disconnect

reconnect.ramble: Attempt to reconnect to the most recently opened location <1> { ppath } </1> upon opening the app, skipping the "Connect to Pocket" button
reconnect.title: Reconnect when the app is opened

keep_platform_data.ramble: This will change Update All & single-core updates to not update existing platform data (images & info) by default, turn it on if you've set up custom data.
keep_platform_data.title: Don't Replace Platform Files During Updates

turbo_downloads.ramble: Enabling this setting will break up files from the archive into smaller chunks. These chunks are then downloaded in parallel, potentially resulting in up to an 8x speedup. However, this method will consume more bandwidth and may be less reliable. If you enable this, please consider <1>supporting the Internet Archive</1>.
turbo_downloads.title: Fast Downloads

hidden_cores.title: Hidden Cores
hidden_cores.ramble:
These cores are hidden from the list of available uninstalled cores, if installed they are not hidden. 
You can hide cores from their info pages.

gb_palettes_conversion.title: GB Palettes Formats
gb_palettes_conversion.ramble:
Duplicate the .pal files into .gbp files. Copies the 4 colours used for the background into the new .gbp files.
Toggling will create a .gbp file for every .pal file in /Assets/gb/common/palettes

demo_updates.title: Demo Data
demo_updates.ramble: Previews UI states with made-up data. Cores: the first three installed cores show an update (updating one reinstalls its current version). Firmware: a newer firmware shows as available. Plugins: three made-up plugins are listed; Run only shows the running state. Nothing on the SD card changes.
demo_updates.firmware_checkbox: Pretend a firmware update is out

dismissed_notes.title: Dismissed Notes
dismissed_notes.ramble: Info notes you've closed, like the tip about dragging in .zip files, can be shown again.
dismissed_notes.button: {count, plural, =0 {Show Notes Again} one {Show # Note Again} other {Show # Notes Again}}

loading_preview.title: Loading Preview
loading_preview.ramble: The spinners and progress bars used while something loads. The slider changes the spinner's speed here only; the app uses {default} ms per frame.

modal_previews.title: Modal previews
modal_previews.ramble: Opens screens with made-up data to check how they look: the photo export with generated photos, the update progress playing a scripted update (it holds at the chosen phase), MiSTer Sync with made-up saves, Move MROM Dumps and Build Instance JSON with made-up cartridges and cores, and the error screen with a made-up error. Nothing is downloaded or changed on the SD card, except photos you export.
